sources.title: mmBERT: a Multilingual Modern Encoder through Adaptive Scheduling
sources.snippet: Overall, mmBERT is the first model to show significant improvements over XLM-R for massively multilingual data while also introducing new techniques for multilingual LM pre-training that apply to both encoders and decoders.
